stories.title: One for You, One for Me
stories.theme: Sharing and fair shares
stories.blurb: Spike the hedgehog doesn't want to share the six apples that fell from the tree. But when he sees his hungry friends, he counts the apples and shares them out fairly: “one for you, one for me.”

stories.title: Ela's First Day at School
stories.theme: Settling in at school
stories.blurb: On the first morning of school, Ela doesn't want to leave her mum, and her tummy is all in knots. She finds the shy toys, tells her new friend Can the order of the day, and Mum comes back just like she said.

stories.title: Whose Turn to Talk?
stories.theme: Taking turns to talk and listening
stories.blurb: At circle time everyone talks at once, and Deniz's tiny whisper gets lost. When Miss Selin's blue talking stone goes round from hand to hand, even the smallest voice is heard.

stories.title: Can, Helper of the Day
stories.theme: Helper of the day
stories.blurb: Today Can is the helper of the day: he turns the calendar and puts up the weather. When it is the class fish Carrot's turn, he wants to give him a great big handful of food; but first he stops, asks, and measures the food against Carrot's eye.

stories.title: Where Is Ali's Apple?
stories.theme: First sounds
stories.blurb: In the classroom every cubby has a picture card, but one morning Ali's apple card goes missing. Ela the sound detective listens to first sounds, finds the lost cards and matches everyone with their own card.

stories.title: How Do I Feel Today?
stories.theme: Recognising feelings
stories.blurb: Ali's day starts all fizzy; then the last piece of his puzzle goes missing, and his cat Cinnamon grabs his hat. Breathing with Mum, Ali discovers that every feeling has a sign in the body, and that he is loved however he feels.

stories.title: Bubbly Hands
stories.theme: Washing hands
stories.blurb: Ela gets muddy hands playing in the garden with her dog Paws. As she reaches for Grandpa's watermelon she suddenly stops: first water, then bubbles!

stories.title: The Toys Go Home
stories.theme: Tidying up toys and keeping order
stories.blurb: When the living room fills up with toys, Cinnamon the dog can't find his yellow ball. Elif takes a deep breath, sends every toy back to its own home, and a surprise appears!

stories.title: Tabby's Water Bowl
stories.theme: Kindness to animals in the heat
stories.blurb: On a hot, hot day, Ali notices that the street cat Tabby's water bowl is completely empty. Together with Grandpa, he finds a cool way to help without touching, from far away.

stories.title: Why Do Leaves Fall?
stories.theme: Autumn and the changing seasons
stories.blurb: When the leaves of the great big tree in the meadow turn yellow and fall, Deniz thinks the tree is ill. Gathering the leaves and sorting them by colour with Hazel the squirrel, she learns how trees get ready for winter.

stories.title: The Ants Get Ready for Winter
stories.theme: Getting ready for winter, counting and helping each other
stories.blurb: Patter the ant has to carry seven grains of wheat to the nest before the rain comes. On the way she helps Dotty the ladybird, whose wings are wet with dew; then the ants carry, Dotty counts, and nobody is left alone in the rain.

stories.title: Step by Step in the Lantern Parade
stories.theme: Republic Day and walking together
stories.blurb: On the evening of Republic Day, Zeynep and Can become the lantern keepers. When Can's steps get muddled in the parade, an outstretched hand and the beat of the drum put everything right.

stories.title: Little Graze, Big Help
stories.theme: Asking for help and first aid after an accident
stories.blurb: Deniz falls while running in the park and scrapes her knee. Her friend Ali knows what to do: he doesn't touch the graze, he tells the teacher, and he fetches the first-aid kit.

stories.title: Drop, Cover, Hold On!
stories.theme: Earthquake drill and disaster preparedness
stories.blurb: When the drill bell rings, Zeynep gets flustered, but she remembers the turtle and takes a deep breath: Drop, cover, hold on! Elif shows her own way in her wheelchair: Lock, cover, hold on.

stories.title: Mumble Brushes His Teeth
stories.theme: Brushing teeth
stories.blurb: After eating honey, Mumble the bear cub is very tired and wants to go to bed without brushing his teeth. But when he runs his tongue over his teeth, he says “Sticky, sticky!” and picks up the brush for a sparkly smile.

stories.title: Deniz and the New Baby
stories.theme: A new baby in the family
stories.blurb: When tiny Ekin comes home, everyone runs to the baby; when Deniz shouts “Waaah!”, nobody comes. Deniz tells her mum how she feels, and the teeny-tiny things that come out of an old box show her how good it is to be a big sister.

stories.title: When the Tower Fell Down
stories.theme: Anger and patience
stories.blurb: Zeynep's great big tower comes down with one touch from baby Ekin. Zeynep gets very angry; she breathes with Dad, calms down and builds the tower again with her baby sibling.

stories.title: Five Little Chicks
stories.theme: Counting (1–5) and compassion
stories.blurb: When evening comes, Can counts the chicks into the coop: one, two, three, four… Where is Sweetie, the fifth chick? Can and Grandma set off to find the littlest chick for the worried mama hen.

stories.title: Moo, Baa, Quack: Morning on the Farm
stories.theme: Animal sounds and taking turns to speak
stories.blurb: Every morning on the farm there's a song: “Moo, baa, quack, cheep!” But today everyone sings so loudly that Cotton the lamb's little voice gets lost.

stories.title: Shape Hunt in the Street
stories.theme: Geometric shapes and everyday signs
stories.blurb: The walk to the bakery feels so long to Zeynep. Grandpa suggests a game: a shape hunt! A round clock, triangle ears, square windows… Suddenly the street is full of shapes.

stories.title: Wet or Dry?
stories.theme: Opposites and respecting different preferences
stories.blurb: Jade the frog loves wet puddles, but Woolly the lamb wants to stay bone dry. One wet, one dry: how will two friends play together?

stories.title: Good Morning, Good Night
stories.theme: Greetings for the time of day
stories.blurb: Sleepy Ali blurts out “Good night!” to his neighbour Granny Nazlı one morning and feels embarrassed. With Grandpa's secret, he finds the right greeting all day long: Look at the sky, find the greeting!

stories.title: Croak's Great Big Voice
stories.theme: Adjusting your voice to the place
stories.blurb: Croak the frog has a great big voice, and his song is loud, loud, loud! But one midday, when the sleeping ducklings wake up, Croak discovers the tiny side of his voice.

stories.title: Grandpa and the Lost Glasses
stories.theme: Following clues and laughing at yourself
stories.blurb: Deniz wants to hear a story, but Grandpa's glasses are missing! The little detective asks questions and follows the clues; when the glasses turn up, it's Grandpa who laughs the hardest, at himself.

stories.title: Grandma's Story Chest
stories.theme: Storytelling and family bonds
stories.blurb: When Zeynep can't sleep, her grandma tells her the tale of a snowy village with a lantern, a bell and a scarf from her old story chest. But the end of the tale is up to Zeynep!

stories.title: The Rhyme Hunt
stories.theme: Rhyming words (phonological awareness)
stories.blurb: Caramel the cat and Wiggle the hedgehog want to write a song, but the words trip and stumble: click, clack. When Buzz the bee hums “Bee, tree! Cat, hat!”, a rhyme hunt begins in the meadow!

stories.title: Hoppy Hops the Syllables
stories.theme: Breaking words into syllables
stories.blurb: Hoppy the rabbit says words syllable by syllable, hopping as she goes: Hop-py, two hops! Shelly the tortoise can't hop and counts wrong at first, then finds his own way to count syllables: step by step.

stories.title: Can Chooses His Book
stories.theme: Choosing a book: reading the cover pictures
stories.blurb: At story time a ball rolls away and books tumble off the shelf. Can doesn't know which one to choose. A deep breath, the pictures on the covers… Will Can be able to choose his book all by himself?

stories.title: Hoot's Picture Letter
stories.theme: A picture letter: visual reading, symbols and writing
stories.blurb: Little Hoot the owl can't write yet, but he wants to invite his friends to a full-moon party. Can Wiggle and Tangerine work out from his picture letter when and where to meet, and what to bring?

stories.title: Deniz's Picture Recipe
stories.theme: Visual reading, a picture recipe
stories.blurb: Dad and Deniz are going to make fruit salad, but the recipe from school has no words at all! “I can't read,” says Deniz. Then she discovers that pictures can be read too, and becomes the kitchen's recipe reader.

stories.title: The Snowman's Snowballs
stories.theme: Comparing big, medium and small, ordering and cooperation
stories.blurb: When snow falls, Ela and her dad roll three snowballs: big, medium and tiny. But which one should go at the bottom? After one tumbling try, Ela finds the right order, and Fluffy the sparrow becomes the snowman's friend.

stories.title: The Home-Grown Table
stories.theme: Home-grown food, where food comes from and not wasting it
stories.blurb: Can goes to the market for the Home-Grown Food table and wants to buy everything; one question from Elif gets him counting on his fingers, and he buys five Amasya apples for five people. At the table, when the milk, eggs, honey and apples find their “homes”, Can takes care of every drop and every bite.

stories.title: The Bird in My Money Box
stories.theme: Saving and waiting (Thrift, Savings and Home-Grown Goods Week)
stories.blurb: Ali wants to buy a feeder for the hungry sparrows in the snow, but there are only three coins in his money box. Every evening he drops in one coin, takes a deep breath even in front of the red balloon, and a week later the bird in his money box flies out into the garden.

stories.title: Where Did the Ice Go?
stories.theme: Melting ice: sun and shade, observing, predicting and waiting patiently
stories.blurb: On a hot summer's day Ela puts ice in a glass; a little later there's only water in it. Where did the ice go? Ela goes out to the garden with Mum; she puts one glass in the sun and one in the shade, and waits patiently.

stories.title: I Can Dress Myself!
stories.theme: Getting dressed on your own
stories.blurb: Big soft snowflakes are falling! Ali wants to get dressed all by himself, but when he puts his mittens on first he can't hold anything. He takes a deep breath, finds the right order himself and walks in the snow in the purple hat he chose.

stories.title: Bunny Ears
stories.theme: Tying shoelaces, trying without giving up
stories.blurb: Before going to the park, Can wants to tie his own laces, but the bow keeps coming undone. “I can't do it!” he says. Grandpa shows him the word “yet” and the bunny ears; from huge to tiny, Can tries and tries until he ties his own bow.

stories.title: The Sleep Train
stories.theme: Bedtime routine and rest
stories.blurb: The moon is out, but Can doesn't want to stop playing: “I'm not sleepy!” When Dad toots the whistle, the sleep train sets off; it passes through the toy stop, the teeth stop and the story stop, and arrives at a sweet sleep.

stories.title: Grandma's Saz
stories.theme: Fast and slow tunes, calming down
stories.blurb: One evening on the farm, Grandma plays her saz. With the fast tune, Cotton the lamb goes hop, hop, hop; but when bedtime comes, she can't stop. Ela finds the slow tune on Grandma's saz, and Cotton slows down, and so does Ela's heart.

stories.title: Why Does the Moon Change?
stories.theme: Phases of the moon and watching the sky
stories.blurb: One evening Ela sees a thin little crescent in the sky and thinks someone has taken a bite out of the moon. With Hoot the owl, she watches the moon every evening for two weeks and draws it in her notebook; on a cloudy evening she learns to wait, and in the end she discovers from her own drawings that the moon is always round.

stories.title: A Rainbow on My Plate
stories.theme: Healthy eating: a colourful plate
stories.blurb: Ask Ela, and she would eat pasta for breakfast, lunch and dinner! When she goes rainbow hunting with Grandma in the vegetable garden, she picks orange carrots, a red apple and green and purple grapes; she sorts the colours and decides for herself which colour to taste.

stories.title: When the Screen Goes to Sleep
stories.theme: Screen time and active play
stories.blurb: Zeynep just can't tear herself away from the tablet. When the sand in the timer runs out, she gets cross; she breathes with Grandpa and puts the tablet to sleep with her own hand. Then it's time for jumping, hide and seek and a story in the living room!

stories.title: Ela Asks First
stories.theme: Digital safety: asking a grown-up first
stories.blurb: While Ela is playing a balloon game, a sparkly box pops open on the screen with a great big present inside. Ela's finger stops in mid-air. She runs to her mum, and together they find a rule: Stop, ask, decide together!

stories.title: Shelly's Code Path
stories.theme: A code path with symbols, finding and fixing the bug
stories.blurb: Shelly the thirsty tortoise wants to get to the pond; Hoppy the rabbit lays out a code path of shape cards on the ground. But there's a “jump!” card in the code, and Shelly can't jump! The two friends find the mistake, fix the code and reach the pond by a new path.

stories.title: Bayram Morning at Grandpa's
stories.theme: Bayram traditions, respect for elders and taking turns to speak
stories.blurb: On Bayram morning, Zeynep has so much to tell her grandpa! She kisses hands, serves the treats herself and remembers who likes what. Then she waits her turn and listens to Grandpa's story of Bayram in the village when he was a boy.

stories.title: A Slow Walk with Grandma
stories.theme: Keeping pace with an elderly grandparent and helping
stories.blurb: Can wants to run to the park, but Grandma walks slowly with her stick. Can carries Grandma's basket and makes a plan to rest at the benches; at the rest stops, Grandma shows him hidden treasures too.

stories.title: Ela Felt a Bit Jealous
stories.theme: Jealousy and friendship
stories.blurb: When Ela's best friend Zeynep plays ball with Elif, who is new to the park, a knot forms in Ela's tummy. Ela names her feeling, breathes with her mum and opens her heart to Zeynep; with the game Elif comes up with, all three play together.

stories.title: Can's Friend Is Moving Away
stories.theme: A friend moving away, saying goodbye
stories.blurb: Can's best friend Deniz is moving to another city. Can sobs and sobs, talks with his mum about how crying can help too, and makes Deniz a box full of their shared memories.

stories.title: Deniz Told the Truth
stories.theme: Honesty and responsibility
stories.blurb: Deniz's ball lands on Grandpa's flowers, and nobody sees. She thinks about hiding the ball; but as the knot in her tummy grows, she decides to tell the truth. With Grandpa, she stands the flowers up again, and they plant a new seed in place of the broken one.

stories.title: Everyone Can Join In
stories.theme: Standing up to exclusion and including everyone in the game (World Children's Day, 20 November)
stories.blurb: When Can says “You can't play!” in the park, Deniz is left all alone on the bench. Zeynep goes over to Deniz, waits her turn to tell the teacher and sets up a ball circle that everyone can join. In the end, Can joins the circle too.

stories.title: My Turn on the Swing
stories.theme: Waiting for your turn and sharing turns fairly
stories.blurb: Two swings in the park, three friends. Ela gets very cross, but she takes a deep breath and finds an idea: “Five swings each, then we swap!”

stories.title: Let's Carry the Big Box Together
stories.theme: Asking for help and working together (cooperation)
stories.blurb: Ali wants to make a playhouse out of a great big box, but the box won't even budge. He takes a deep breath and asks his friends for help; with Elif's idea, “One, two, three, all together!”, the box lifts into the air.

stories.title: Everyone Has a Job at Home
stories.theme: Sharing jobs at home, responsibility and matching
stories.blurb: Spring is here and the winter clothes are being put away: Dad folds the towels, Mum waters the flowers. Every job Zeynep tries goes wrong; then she spots the tipped-over winter basket, matches the hats with the scarves by colour, and the family goes off on a picnic together.

stories.title: What Will I Be When I Grow Up?
stories.theme: Jobs and dreams
stories.blurb: On Jobs Day, Dr Aslı comes to the class; the tools in her bag make Elif burst with curiosity. A stethoscope, a thermometer, a plaster... So what does Elif want to be when she grows up?

stories.title: My Body, My Voice
stories.theme: Body safety: permission, saying no, telling a trusted grown-up
stories.blurb: Someone tickles Zeynep, doesn't stop when she says “Stop!” and tells her, “Don't tell anyone!” But Zeynep knows: we don't keep secrets about touching.

stories.title: Knock Knock, May I Come In?
stories.theme: Knocking on the door, asking permission and privacy in the bathroom
stories.blurb: Can needs a wee and bursts into the bathroom without knocking; his dad is in there! Dad laughs and teaches him the door rule: Knock knock, may I come in? And in the evening, guess who comes knocking?

stories.title: The Doctor Listened to My Heart
stories.theme: A health check-up, asking permission and calming down with your breath
stories.blurb: Ali is a little nervous about his check-up at the health centre. Dr Nazlı asks permission first, and they breathe together; when Ali hears his own heart going thump thump through the stethoscope, he is amazed.

stories.title: Why Is Hoppy Puffing?
stories.theme: My body changes when I move
stories.blurb: Hoppy the rabbit runs and runs across the meadow until he is worn out; his heart goes thump thump and he puffs, huff huff. He thinks he is ill. When he rests with his friends and tries his own experiment, he discovers his body's secret.

stories.title: Heavy as an Elephant, Light as an Ant
stories.theme: Adjusting your steps to the place you are in, and care for living things
stories.blurb: Can is walking stomp, stomp across the meadow with Tubby the baby elephant. But there is a line of ants on the path! Can Can manage to walk as light as an ant?

stories.title: A Big Drink of Water
stories.theme: Healthy drinks: water when you're thirsty
stories.blurb: Zeynep comes home thirsty from the park, and her eye lands on the orange, sugary drink. With Dad, she listens to her tongue, has a big drink of water and makes up a game for sorting the drinks.

stories.title: The Hide-and-Seek Counter
stories.theme: Counting honestly in hide-and-seek and fair rules for everyone
stories.blurb: The friends play hide-and-seek at the park, but Elif's wheels sink into the sand and she is always found first. Elif takes a deep breath and suggests two new rules for the game. And Ali, the seeker, never peeks, however curious he gets.

stories.title: Green Light, Let's Walk
stories.theme: Crossing safely at the zebra crossing, traffic lights and waiting
stories.blurb: The swings are creaking across the road, and Can's feet are itching to go! But the red man is lit up on the traffic light. With his mum and his dog Cinnamon, Can turns waiting into a game: Stop, look, listen!

stories.title: Obstacle Course Day with Dad
stories.theme: Moving safely, balance and staying flexible when plans change
stories.blurb: On Father's Day, Elif gives her dad an obstacle course day in the park. At the first bend, a puddle left over from yesterday's rain spoils the plan, so Elif suggests moving the course to the dry grass; she and Dad carry the stones together.

stories.title: Is Mumble Big or Small?
stories.theme: Comparing big and small
stories.blurb: At breakfast, Mumble the little bear wants his mum's great big bowl, but the bowl is far too heavy. Then he has an idea: sort out the big things and the small things! In the end he says, “Just right for me!”

stories.title: Where Did Squirrel Hide His Hazelnuts?
stories.theme: Position words and asking a friend for help
stories.blurb: Crunch the squirrel hides three hazelnuts for the winter, but when winter comes he forgets where he put them! Chirp the sparrow and Cinnamon the fox give him clues: “under, behind, between,” and the hazelnuts are found one by one.

stories.title: How Long Is the Elephant?
stories.theme: Measuring length with non-standard units
stories.blurb: Buttons the baby elephant boasts, “I'm the longest in the meadow!” But when Hoppy measures her as three and Spike measures her as eight, she gets confused: has she grown, or are the steps just different?

stories.title: The Class's Favourite Fruit
stories.theme: Collecting data and deciding fairly with an object graph
stories.blurb: The class can take just one kind of fruit on the picnic: watermelon, grapes or bananas? When everyone shouts at once, Elif has an idea: everyone picks one fruit, we line them up on the board, and we count!

stories.title: The Ducklings Line Up
stories.theme: Ordinal numbers and waiting your turn
stories.blurb: When five ducklings try to jump into the lake all at once, they bump and tumble into each other. Croak the frog teaches them the line-up game, and little Pip, right at the back, finds a big surprise waiting at the end of his wait.

stories.title: The Ladybird's Spot Game
stories.theme: Part and whole: the hidden and visible parts of five
stories.blurb: Dotty the ladybird loves counting. She plays hide-and-seek with Flutter the butterfly using five black spot stones: if three stones can be seen, how many are hidden behind the bush?

stories.title: Grandma's Patterned Kilim
stories.theme: Patterns (AB-AB) and coping with anger
stories.blurb: Can and his grandma lay out the design for the new kilim rug on the floor: star, triangle, star, triangle. When Cinnamon the cat grabs two pieces and runs off, Can gets very angry; but he takes a breath, finds the pieces and reads the pattern to fill the gaps in the right order.

stories.title: Elif's Patient Seed
stories.theme: Watching a seed grow and learning to wait
stories.blurb: Elif plants a teeny sunflower seed in the vegetable garden with her grandpa and wants a flower the very next morning. Waiting is hard, but Elif makes up her own watering song; with water, sun and a little patience, the seed becomes a shoot, then leaves, then a great big flower.

stories.title: Hedgehog Cleans the Forest
stories.theme: Keeping our surroundings clean
stories.blurb: Spike the hedgehog bumps his nose on a can left over from a picnic: clonk! Spike, Tufty and Cinnamon count five pieces of rubbish one by one, carry them to the yellow bin together, and the forest smells fresh again.

stories.title: A New Life for the Boxes
stories.theme: Sorting waste and recycling (World Environment Day)
stories.blurb: Cleaning up the park on World Environment Day, Deniz throws all the waste into the same bin: “Rubbish is rubbish!” But Elif has an idea: every piece of waste has its own home. Blue, yellow, green… The papers they sort together one day become brand new notebooks.

stories.title: The Drip-Drop Tap
stories.theme: Saving water
stories.blurb: While Can brushes his teeth, the tap runs splish splash. When Puffy the Cloud at the window tells him about every drop's long journey from the sea, Can turns into a water detective.

stories.title: Buzz the Bee's Long Journey
stories.theme: Bees, pollen and how fruit grows
stories.blurb: Little Buzz the bee wants to carry yellow pollen to the lonely apple tree at the far end of the meadow. The way is long, but when she flies together with Flutter the butterfly, the flowers one day turn into bright red apples.

stories.title: How Does a Frog Grow?
stories.theme: Observing the life cycle of a frog and adapting to change
stories.blurb: Cotton the duck finds jelly-like eggs in the pond. When tiny tailed creatures hatch, she thinks they are baby fish and gives them swimming lessons. But the little ones change a bit every day: legs grow, tails shrink, and one morning they hop onto the shore!

stories.title: Tree Planting Day
stories.theme: Planting saplings, making homes for living things and working together
stories.blurb: The class goes to plant saplings in an empty meadow. When they see Patter the squirrel, who can't find a tree to climb, Zeynep and Ali get to work: one holds, one presses down the soil, and then they give the saplings their first drink.

stories.title: Who Comes Out in the Rain?
stories.theme: Observing living things in the rain, and kindness
stories.blurb: When the spring rain goes pitter patter, Ela goes out to the meadow with her grandpa. Who is hiding behind the stones? Ela calls Curly, the little snail in the middle of the stone path, over to the grass with a fresh leaf, without touching him.

stories.title: Sink or Float?
stories.theme: Sinking and floating: predict, try, observe, sort; being able to say honestly that you were wrong
stories.blurb: Ali and Zeynep think big things sink and small things float. When the huge block floats in Miss Selin's bowl of water and the tiny coin sinks, they both laugh and say, “I was wrong!”

stories.title: The Five Senses Market
stories.theme: Observing with the five senses
stories.blurb: Deniz goes to the local market with her grandpa. When the noise gets too much, she takes a deep breath; she smells with her nose, knows things by touch, sorts with her eyes and tastes with her tongue. In the end she can tell the market even with her eyes closed.

stories.title: Shadow Play Night
stories.theme: Traditional shadow theatre, shapes and shadows, telling a story in front of an audience
stories.blurb: On a moonlit night, Grandpa tells Deniz about the Karagoz shadow screen of his childhood and sets up a little shadow play in the room. Deniz cuts her own heart out of cardboard, matches the shadows to their figures, and then overcomes her nerves to put on her own tiny show.

stories.title: Colours on the Water
stories.theme: The art of ebru (paper marbling) and working slowly, with patience
stories.blurb: On a rainy day, Grandma shows Elif how to paint on water: ebru, the art of marbling. When Elif rushes, the paints mix like mud; Elif takes a deep breath, finds her “snail hands” and patiently makes her own ebru with tulips.

stories.title: When Yellow Meets Blue
stories.theme: Mixing colours and painting together
stories.blurb: Painting a picture for Teachers' Day, Can has only yellow paint and Elif has only blue. The meadow needs green! What will happen when yellow meets blue?

stories.title: Puffy Looks for the Rainbow
stories.theme: Colours and beauty
stories.blurb: The rain stops, but no rainbow appears. Puffy the cloud and Flutter the butterfly set off on a colour hunt in the meadow.

stories.title: Grandma's Art Show
stories.theme: Respect for works of art and the artist; expressing feelings about a work
stories.blurb: Zeynep's grandma hangs her paintings in the living room and opens an exhibition at home; the first visitor is Zeynep. Noticing that her grandma feels shy, Zeynep looks at the paintings slowly; she finds out which were painted from life and which from imagination, and says how each painting makes her feel, and why.

stories.title: The Animals in the Stones
stories.theme: Nature art in the sand
stories.blurb: On the beach, Ali finds stones and shells that look like a turtle and a fish; he wants to take them all home. When Mum says “This is where they belong,” Ali has an idea: he makes a great big fish on the sand out of stones, and leaves it on the shore.

stories.title: Tick: A Robot from Bottle Tops
stories.theme: Designing together by reusing waste
stories.blurb: On a rainy day, Can and Elif rescue the bottle tops and cardboard tubes that were headed for the recycling. Their hurried robot comes crashing down, but with Elif's step-by-step plan and Dad's tape, a smiling robot is born: Tick!

stories.title: A Great Big Picture for Mum
stories.theme: Showing love with pictures and words
stories.blurb: Deniz secretly makes a great big picture with her dad for Mother's Day. Mum very nearly sees it! At last Deniz hands over the picture and tells her mum, in her own words, why she loves her.

stories.title: The Statue in the Square
stories.theme: Getting to know statues, telling a picture from a statue, looking after a work of art
stories.blurb: Ela sees a great big sparrow in the square. She calls to it, she sings to it. But the sparrow doesn't move at all! When she looks closely, she discovers the sparrow's secret all by herself.

stories.title: The Clay Tortoise
stories.theme: Making things patiently
stories.blurb: Ali wants to make the tortoise in the picture out of clay, but his hurried tortoise falls apart. With Miss Nur's words he slows down: roll, press, and put the legs on one by one.

stories.title: Clap, Clap, Boom!
stories.theme: Body percussion and sound patterns
stories.blurb: Mumble has no drum, but Mama Bear says his drum is always with him: clap, clap, boom! When Mumble rushes and muddles it up, he stops, breathes, listens and finds the rhythm.

stories.title: Low Voice, High Voice
stories.theme: Telling low and high sounds apart; respecting different voices
stories.blurb: Bombo the elephant has a very low voice: Booom! At the forest concert he longs to sing high like Tweet, so he goes quiet, and the song isn't complete. What will happen when the low voice, the high voice and the middle voice come together?

stories.title: The Spoon and Bowl Orchestra
stories.theme: Making rhythms with kitchen things, listening and repeating in turns
stories.blurb: On a rainy day, Grandpa sets up an orchestra in the kitchen with steel bowls, unbreakable plates and spoons. Ali and Zeynep make up their own rhythms, but when they both play at once, the rhythms get lost. After a breath, the children find the echo game and taking turns all by themselves.

stories.title: When the Music Stops, Stop!
stories.theme: Fast and slow tempo and being able to stop (statue dance)
stories.blurb: It's statue dance time in class: when the music plays, you dance; when the music stops, you're a statue! Zeynep's feet just won't stop. Can's magic word makes saying “Stop!” easier.

stories.title: The 23 April Song
stories.theme: Writing a song together for 23 April, coping with nerves and singing hand in hand
stories.blurb: Miss Nur's class writes a song about the children of the world for 23 April, Children's Day. At rehearsal, Deniz's voice hides away from nerves. With Elif's balloon idea, her voice grows little by little!

stories.title: The Birds' Evening Concert
stories.theme: Listening to the sounds of nature
stories.blurb: One evening, Elif wants to listen to the forest's concert; but when she shouts with excitement, the sparrows fly away. Taking a deep breath and closing her eyes, Elif listens to the sparrows going to sleep, the owl waking up, and the song of silence.

stories.title: Butter to Sell, Honey to Sell
stories.theme: A traditional circle game: walking in rhythm to a song and being ‘it’ together
stories.blurb: Ali, Deniz and Elif play their grandpas' game in the park: Butter to sell, honey to sell! Deniz is sad when she is always ‘it’. Then Elif has a lovely idea.

stories.title: Elif's Ramp
stories.theme: Accessibility: the park is for everyone
stories.blurb: The slide in the new park only has steps, and Elif's wheelchair can't climb steps. Elif looks for sloping paths, comes up with the ramp idea and dictates a letter to the council: “Let everyone slide!”

stories.title: Mumble the Bear Cub Can't Sleep
stories.blurb: A sound in the night frightens Mumble. His mum teaches him a little trick for dealing with fear.

stories.title: Puffy the Cloud
stories.blurb: A tiny cloud calls her friends to help the thirsty flowers.

stories.title: Shelly Takes Her Time
stories.blurb: Everyone laughs at how slow Shelly is. But one day, being slow and careful turns out to be very useful.
